reason: The initial fastest baseline configuration had only 0.006 degC of headroom and failed the first larger-span confirmation at 1.1803723416 degC. This post-confirmation revision preserves that failure and reclassifies that case as development evidence.
justification: The linear heat equation scales absolute error with initial-to-boundary temperature span. Reducing development error to at most 0.8 degC provides margin for the observed 95/80 span ratio without relaxing the original 1 degC target.
